MGRS conversion: proj4js/mgrs 2.2.0, https://github.com/proj4js/mgrs.
Vendored from its npm-distributed ESM build. The source-map footer was removed.
See mgrs-LICENSE.md and mgrs-OpenMap-LICENSE.md for license and attribution details.
The application uses forward([longitude, latitude], precision); references vary
from three to five digits per axis with zoom. Display lines mark UTM grid zones,
not individual one-meter grid cells.
